**步骤19: writetext**
- 参数: `{"content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"剪贴板内容分析脚本\"\"\"\nimport json\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\n# 剪贴板实际内容（从clipboard_control读取）\nclipboard_content = \"https://platform.sensenova.cn/console/keys\"\n\ndef analyze_clipboard(content):\n    \"\"\"分析剪贴板内容\"\"\"\n    result = {\n        \"timestamp\": datetime.now().strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\"),\n        \"raw_content\": content,\n        \"content_length\": len(content),\n    }\n    \n    # 判断内容类型\n    if content.startswith(\"http://\") or content.startswith(\"https://\"):\n        result[\"content_type\"] = \"URL链接\"\n        result[\"url_parsed\"] = {\n            \"protocol\": content.split(\":\")[0] if \":\" in content else \"unknown\",\n            \"full_url\": content\n        }\n    elif content.endswith(('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.bmp', '.gif')):\n        result[\"content_type\"] = \"图片文件路径\"\n    elif '/' in content or '\\\\' in content:\n        result[\"content_type\"] = \"文件路径\"\n        result[\"file_list\"] = [p.strip() for p in content.split('\\n') if p.strip()]\n    else:\n        result[\"content_type\"] = \"纯文本\"\n    \n    # 猜测来源应用\n    if \"platform.sensenova\" in content.lower():\n        result[\"source_guess\"] = \"SenseNova平台控制台 (浏览器)\"\n    elif \"github\" in content.lower():\n        result[\"source_guess\"] = \"GitHub相关\"\n    elif \"api\" in content.lower():\n        result[\"source_guess\"] = \"API文档/配置页面\"\n    else:\n        result[\"source_guess\"] = \"未知应用（可能是浏览器或文本编辑器）\"\n    \n    return result\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    analysis = analyze_clipboard(clipboard_content)\n    \n    output_lines = []\n    output_lines.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    output_lines.append(\"剪贴板分析报告\")\n    output_lines.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    output_lines.append(f\"分析时间: {analysis['timestamp']}\")\n    output_lines.append(\"\")\n    output_lines.append(\"--- 基本信息 ---\")\n    output_lines.append(f\"原始内容: {analysis['raw_content']}\")\n    output_lines.append(f\"内容长度: {analysis['content_length']} 字符\")\n    output_lines.append(f\"内容类型: {analysis['content_type']}\")\n    output_lines.append(f\"来源猜测: {analysis['source_guess']}\")\n    \n    if 'url_parsed' in analysis:\n        output_lines.append(f\"URL协议: {analysis['url_parsed']['protocol']}\")\n        output_lines.append(f\"完整URL: {analysis['url_parsed']['full_url']}\")\n    \n    if 'file_list' in analysis:\n        output_lines.append(f\"文件数量: {len(analysis['file_list'])}\")\n        for i, f in enumerate(analysis['file_list'], 1):\n            output_lines.append(f\"  [{i}] {f}\")\n    \n    output_lines.append(\"\")\n    output_lines.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    output_lines.append(\"报告结束\")\n    output_lines.append(\"=\" * 60)\n    \n    output_text = \"\\n\".join(output_lines)\n    \n    with open(r\"E:\\test_dir\\clipboard_analysis.txt\", \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        f.write(output_text)\n    \n    print(output_text)\n    print(\"\\n[保存至 E:\\\\test_dir\\\\clipboard_analysis.txt]\")\n", "path": "E:\\test_dir\\clipboard_analyzer.py"}`
